# `try_make_timestamp`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Try to create a timestamp from year, month, day, hour, min, sec and timezone fields. The result data type is consistent with the value of configuration `spark.sql.timestampType`. The function returns NULL on invalid inputs.

try_make_timestamp(date[, time[, timezone]]) - Try to create a timestamp from date, time, and timezone fields.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_make_timestamp(year, month, day, hour, min, sec[, timezone])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2, 3, 6, 7] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 1
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887);
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 2
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887, 'CET');
2014-12-27 21:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 3
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(DATE'2014-12-28');
2014-12-28 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 4
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887');
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 5
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887', 'CET');
2014-12-27 21:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 6
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(2019, 6, 30, 23, 59, 60);
2019-07-01 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 7
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(2019, 6, 30, 23, 59, 1);
2019-06-30 23:59:01
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 8
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(null, 7, 22, 15, 30, 0);
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_make_timestamp, example 9
> SELECT try_make_timestamp(2024, 13, 22, 15, 30, 0);
NULL
```
